_comment: Full title-screen loop: boot at title, New Game, walk to the inn door (autosave beat, now floodplains-bound per M-FP W2's door retarget), Quit to Title with confirm, Continue, verify restored state. starts_at_title bypasses the harness title-skip so this script drives the gate/menu directly. Issue #43 re-pin: headless QA runs a DEBUG binary, so the new debug-only 'Playtest States' row IS visible here -- both ui_title_rendered waits now pin selectable_rows (the device-of-truth row count, read live off OS.is_debug_build()/Continue's own enabled state, not hardcoded) to prove the gate is live: 3 selectable rows before any save exists (New Game/Playtest States/Quit -- Continue skipped), 4 once the autosave lands (Continue newly selectable). Existing navigation (move down 1 to reach Continue on the second title render) is UNCHANGED -- Playtest States sits after Continue in ROWS, so it doesn't shift any prior step's cursor math.
